# etchplan-opencode

**Etchplan capture plugin for opencode.**

This npm entry currently **reserves the name**. The plugin records an opencode session's tool
calls locally so Etchplan can mine your repeated workflows and compile them into cheap, guarded,
deterministic routines.

In active development at
[github.com/Davidobot/agent-compiler](https://github.com/Davidobot/agent-compiler); full release to
follow. Licensed under Apache-2.0.
